tradeoff: None until the names are cleared.
entry: The owner chose Zoetrope for the server and Praxi for the viewer apps ("Zoetrope and praxei make sense to me"), a naming convention for all of the project's software after the early moving-picture devices. A first proposal was set aside after the lead found it collides with existing media software. JS-200 renames only after a name check clears both and the owner approves; the organisation's rename and logo are the owner's, in the web interface. PRODUCT.md names them as chosen and keeps the working names until the rename lands.
